messages:
maria (docs): Heads up — we need to publish the v1 sunset roadmap and a short migration companion for the upcoming model swaps. I’m thinking staged comms: dev preview -> internal beta -> public notice (60 days) -> sunset. Any major objections?

kevin (eng-runtime): +1 on staged. We must lock down the alias mapping for embedding and chat endpoints. I’ll add the mapping table in the PR and verify runtime fallback behavior.

tony (sdk): FYI, SDKs have a subtle param rename that will break a few Quickstart snippets: `stream` -> `streaming`. We should update all code samples and add a backward-compat warning. Quick example to update:
```
# old
client.generate({ model: "rwd-embed-1", stream: true })

# new
client.generate({ model: "rwd-embed-1", streaming: true })
```

sasha (product): Enterprise customers need clear options. Can we offer a compatibility flag on Dedicated for ~90 days to preserve old behavior? If not, list explicit breaking points in the public notice.

jess (techwriter): I can draft the migration companion. What should be included? My initial list: code diffs (old vs new), redirect/alias map, QA checklist for SDKs and docs, and a set of PRs to update (Quickstart, Embeddings guide, Model selection).

lisa (pm): Add support KB updates and canned replies to the rollout plan. Prioritize Quickstart and Embedding migration examples. Also coordinate legal for notice language.

maria (docs): Action items summary: jess opens a draft PR for the migration companion by EOD Wed; tony prepares SDK snippet patches + changelog; kevin attaches model alias mapping + test matrix; sasha to confirm enterprise opt-out window.

docs-bot: PR 4579 created by jess: docs/migration/v1-sunset-draft.md — https://git.redwood/PR/4579

tony (sdk): Uploaded gists for JS/TS and Python snippets. Quick question — should the canonical snippet use `generate` or switch to `responses.create`? I prefer `responses.create` for clarity.

maria (docs): Let’s standardize on `responses.create` in the guide, but include a short "aliases" callout showing old method names and one-line migrations. Also add a simple smoke test for reviewers:
```
# smoke test
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/responses
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","input":"hello"}'
```

kevin (eng-runtime): I’ll add a unit test that asserts fallback to `rwd-chat-1-lite` when capacity is constrained. Also need infra to seed alias table for the staging rollout.

jess (techwriter): Draft PR link: https://git.redwood/PR/4579/files — please leave inline comments with exact code snippets to replace so I can iterate quickly.

sasha (product): Proposed customer notify date: 2026-04-15. If that works, we should trigger legal and support review this week.

lisa (pm): I’ll schedule comms and create the support KB stub titled "How to migrate SDK usage for v1 -> v2".

kevin (eng-runtime): One more technical note: embedding dims differ for the compact model variant — old: 1536, new compact: 1024 for `rwd-embed-compact`. Add a short conversion note and a compatibility table.

maria (docs): Timeline recap to include in the PR: draft by Wed EOD, internal review Thu, publish beta Mon, public notify 2026-04-15, full sunset 2026-06-15. If anyone objects to dates, speak up now.

tony (sdk): No objections. I’ll open SDK PRs once jess lands the draft.

jess (techwriter): Tagging reviewers: @kevin, @tony, @sasha — will ping when the draft is up.

maria (docs): I’ll update the release-notes template to include deprecation severity and an estimated migration effort field. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
